supersedes.scope: preclaim implementation, claim/start fence, release fence, lease, and watchdog only

preclaim_gate.requirement: The exact owner must exit with a valid snapshot terminal and complete manifest verification. Do not start, retry, rehash, replace, or interrupt checkpoint materialization.

implementation.scope: Copy and make the smallest hash-bound changes for one BF16 control followed by one runtime dynamic-FP8 weight candidate. Reuse shared atomic claim/release and repair-handshake plumbing. Do not perform a full-path preclaim rehearsal or re-read checkpoint shards.

durable_launch.status_requirement: After launch, record the emitted controller-local pid/start_ticks/state path as STATUS.json.active_session and return after one grouped snapshot proves claim heartbeat plus progress past the first exact repaired command.

unchanged_science.order: BF16 control c32, tiny real FP8-consumption probe, runtime dynamic-FP8 c32 candidate
unchanged_science.forbidden: Rejected llmcompressor NVFP4 shards and any replay or checkpoint restaging

repair_disposition: Ordinary launcher, runtime flag/API, path, telemetry, process-start, or retrieval defects remain mutable under the same claim. Retain and repair while science is unconsumed and the remaining release margin fits.

budgets.conservative_exposure_basis: Reservation at 14:51:25Z through 16:45Z is approximately $7.48 at $3.95/hour before the small cleanup margin.
